messages.content: Propose an ordered list of hypotheses from the registered IDs only. Choose model structures only; do not estimate numeric parameters. message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This structure achieves the lowest RMSE among all passing models, indicating the best fit to the observed target trajectory while accounting for both a constant sensor offset and dynamic belt speed changes.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This structure has a very low RMSE, suggesting that a combination of sensor bias and a speed step explains the observations well without the added complexity of a velocity offset.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "This structure matches the RMSE of AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP), indicating that actuator delay does not significantly degrade the fit when combined with sensor bias and speed step.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "This structure has a low RMSE and is the simplest single-factor model that passes, suggesting a constant sensor offset is a primary contributor to the observed deviation.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "This structure matches the RMSE of SENSOR_BIAS, indicating that actuator delay does not significantly change the fit when combined with sensor bias.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "This structure matches the RMSE of SENSOR_BIAS, suggesting that adding a velocity offset to sensor bias does not significantly improve the fit.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "This structure matches the RMSE of SENSOR_BIAS, indicating that the additional factors do not significantly improve the fit over sensor bias alone.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
